cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Pass Me the Authority
cards.instruction: Get someone to transfer authority publicly by naming you as the person who decides what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Hand me the hall key and tell everyone I'm now in charge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't I just give you the key? My retirement taxi's waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. The door will understand. The committee needs words.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're outside asking me whether to cancel Saturday's dance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them I decide whether it goes ahead. Then ask me, in front of them. Your taxi can be my first approval.

mechanism: A coaches its retiring former pupil through publicly naming A successor, turning a live decision into a demonstration of the handover.
confusable: Not merely asking for symbols: B must say A is the decider before the affected audience.
comparison: Retirement handover with a dance decision versus meeting chair verbal transfer.
seedUse: D60 hall/key/taxi/dance; S05 makes B demonstrate learned proper handover.
